title: Scenario 1: Simplified Checkout CTA
question: Your team tested a new checkout CTA copy against the current control. Should you ship the new variant now?
explanation: Correct answer: HOLD. Although the headline win probability is 86%, the 95% credible interval (-9.8% to +34.1%) crosses zero and only 280 of the planned 800 exposures (35%) have been collected. Shipping now risks deploying a ~10% regression.

memo.summary: Do not ship yet: credible interval crosses zero and planned sample is only 35% reached.
reasons: 95% credible interval (-9.8% to +34.1%) includes negative and zero effect.
Misleading headline: 86% win probability masks wide uncertainty.
Planned sample not reached: 280 / 800 total exposures (520 more needed).
memo.next_action: Keep running until 800 total exposures (400 per arm) before re-checking.

checks.name: prob_vs_interval
checks.detail: Win probability 86% > 80% while interval includes zero (misleading headline).
